description: This file defines the ShippingConfiguration class within the shopping cart system, modeling various shipping options, including types, basis, packaging, descriptions, and related financial details, with JSON serialization capabilities.

classes.name: ShippingConfiguration
classes.description: Represents the shipping configuration options for an e-commerce platform, including shipping types, packaging, associated costs, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the ShippingConfiguration object into a JSON string representation.

methods.name: getShippingType
methods.description: Returns the shipping type (e.g., NATIONAL or INTERNATIONAL).

methods.name: setShippingType
methods.description: Sets the shipping type based on the provided enum.

methods.name: getShippingBasisType
methods.description: Returns the shipping basis type (e.g., SHIPPING or BILLING).

methods.name: setShippingBasisType
methods.description: Sets the shipping basis type based on the provided enum.

methods.name: getShippingOptionPriceType
methods.description: Returns the shipping option price type.

methods.name: setShippingOptionPriceType
methods.description: Sets the shipping option price type.

methods.name: getShippingPackageType
methods.description: Returns the package type used for shipping.

methods.name: setShippingPackageType
methods.description: Sets the package type.

methods.name: getShipType
methods.description: Retrieves the string representation of the shipping type.

methods.name: setShipType
methods.description: Sets the shipping type from a string input, updating the enum accordingly.

methods.name: getShipBaseType
methods.description: Retrieves the string representation of the shipping basis type.

methods.name: setShipBaseType

methods.name: getShipOptionPriceType
methods.description: Retrieves the string representation of the shipping option price type.

methods.name: getShipPackageType
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the shipping package type.

methods.name: setShipPackageType
methods.description: Sets the shipping package type from a string.

methods.name: getShipDescription

methods.name: setShipDescription

methods.description: Returns the shipping type designated for free shipping.

methods.name: setFreeShippingType

methods.name: setFreeShippingEnabled

methods.description: Gets the order total threshold for free shipping.
